files.description: Rendered HTML of the EHI export data dictionary index page. Shows the overview text and table listing all 17 FHIR resource datasets with links to individual specification pages. Captured via browser rendering since the site is a JavaScript SPA.
Screenshot of the main EHI export data dictionary page showing the title, introduction text, and dataset listing table.
Additional screenshot of the EHI export data dictionary index page.
Rendered HTML of the EHI export index page with full dataset listing table captured via browser evaluate_script.
Rendered HTML of the AllergyIntolerance dataset specification page showing US Core AllergyIntolerance profile elements, cardinalities, types, bindings, and detailed definitions.
Full-page screenshot of the AllergyIntolerance dataset specification page.
Rendered HTML of the CarePlan dataset specification page showing US Core CarePlan profile elements.
Rendered HTML of the CareTeam dataset specification page showing US Core CareTeam profile elements.

Rendered HTML of the FHIR API documentation page. Contains API access instructions, terms and conditions, full API reference with read/search endpoints for all resource types, and example FHIR JSON responses. Captured via browser rendering.
Screenshot of the API documentation page header section.
Full-page screenshot of the complete FHIR API documentation page.

FHIR CapabilityStatement from the myhELO FHIR server. Documents FHIR 4.0.1 support, SMART-on-FHIR OAuth2 endpoints, 18 supported resource types with interactions and search parameters, Group/$export for bulk data, and software version 3.14.

Machine-readable FHIR API specification containing endpoint definitions and example JSON responses for all 18 resource types (17 EHI export resources plus Group and Location). This is the same data rendered on the API Docs page.

All 17 FHIR R4 StructureDefinitions extracted from the myhELO JavaScript SPA bundle (/js.php). Contains complete US Core profile definitions for all EHI export resource types with snapshot elements, cardinalities, types, value set bindings, and mustSupport flags. Extracted via regex parsing of the get_data_json() method in the minified JS source.

Overview metadata for all 17 EHI export datasets extracted from the JS bundle's get_summary_contents_json() method. Contains titles, brief descriptions, overview text, and supported profile lists for each resource type.
Enrichment script v1: Parses API examples from fhir-well-known.json and CapabilityStatement to produce a field-level data dictionary based on example responses. Run with: bun run extract-api-data.ts
Enrichment output v1: API-focused data dictionary derived from example FHIR JSON responses. Contains field-level definitions for all 17 resource types based on structure observed in examples.
Enrichment report v1: Accounting of the v1 extraction process (files parsed, per-resource stats).

Enrichment script v2 (recommended): Parses full FHIR StructureDefinitions from structure-definitions.json to produce a comprehensive field-level data dictionary with cardinalities, types, bindings, USCDI flagging, and descriptions. Run with: bun run extract-structure-defs.ts

Enrichment output v2: Comprehensive data dictionary with all 17 resource types, 921 total element definitions, 196 USCDI-flagged elements, 203 elements with value set bindings, and 105 required elements. Includes element-level cardinalities, types, descriptions, modifier/summary flags, and binding details.
Enrichment report v2: Accounting of the v2 extraction process with per-resource stats (element counts, USCDI elements, required elements, supported profiles).
Documentation for the enrichment scripts: explains inputs, outputs, usage, and known parsing limitations for both v1 and v2 enrichment approaches.
